name: Basil Pesto
description: Fresh pesto pounded in a mortar or blitzed in a food processor. This file has no category tags and no times, so meal, protein and carb are all inferred.
recipeInstructions:
Toast the pine nuts in a dry pan until pale golden, then cool.
Pound or blitz the garlic with a pinch of salt, then add the pine nuts and basil and work to a coarse paste.
Stir in the parmesan, then loosen with the oil and a squeeze of lemon. Season to taste.
Store in a jar, covered with a thin layer of oil, in the fridge for up to a week.
